newsitem.title: USA: Catellus to sell East Bay shoreline property.
newsitem.headline: Catellus to sell East Bay shoreline property.

text.p: Catellus Development Corp said it executed an agreement with the East Bay Regional Park District and the State of California, Department of Parks and Recreation, to sell the majority of its East Bay shoreline property for $27.5 million.
The land purchase will facilitate the creation of a new regional park that will extend along the San Francisco Bay east shore from Richmond to Emeryville and North Oakland.
The properties involved in this transaction consist of about 1,223 acres of submerged land or intertidal wetlands and 207 acres of undeveloped upland.
